resources.name: FPL Buddy API (connect-fpl-team)
resources.description: Endpoints from the connect-fpl-team openspec change: connect a public FPL Team ID (no login), then read that team's public squad/history/budget. Read-only, no write actions against a real FPL team. Run `docker compose up -d` then `python manage.py runserver` in fpl-buddy-api/ before using this collection.

resources.name: Connection
resources.description: fpl-team-connection capability - identify a visitor by their public FPL Team ID. No FPL password/OAuth involved.

resources.name: Connect (find-or-create by FPL Team ID)
resources.description:
POST a numeric FPL Team ID. Validates it against the live FPL API, finds-or-creates a `users` row keyed on it, and sets a session cookie so subsequent requests in this workspace are recognized without resubmitting the ID.

Responses:
- 200: `{"user_id": "<uuid>", "fpl_team_id": <int>}`
- 400: fpl_team_id missing or not a positive integer
- 404: `{"error": "no FPL entry found for that Team ID"}`
- 502: could not verify the ID with FPL right now

Insomnia will store the returned session cookie automatically (settingStoreCookies) and send it on the Team Data requests below (settingSendCookies) as long as they're all run against the same base_url.

resources.name: Team Data
resources.description: fpl-team-data-retrieval capability - read-only, cache-first (TTL configurable via FPL_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS) reads of the connected team's public FPL data. All requests here require having run Connect first in this workspace (401 otherwise).

resources.name: Get Squad
resources.description:
Current squad: starters, bench, captain, vice-captain, for the connected team's current gameweek.

Responses:
- 200 (picks locked): `{"picks_available": true, "gw": <int>, "starters": [...], "bench": [...], "captain": <element_id>, "vice_captain": <element_id>}`
- 200 (no gw yet, e.g. preseason or pre-deadline): `{"picks_available": false, "gw": null|<int>, "message": "..."}`
- 401: not connected - run Connect first
- 502: could not reach FPL right now

resources.name: Get History
resources.description:
Season history: per-gameweek points/transfers/transfer cost for the current season, plus any chips activated.

Response 200: `{"gw_history": [{"gw": <int>, "points": <int>, "transfers": <int>, "transfer_cost": <int>}, ...], "chips": [{"name": <str>, "gw": <int>}, ...]}`

401 if not connected, 502 if FPL is unreachable.

resources.name: Get Budget
resources.description:
Remaining bank and total squad value, as of the last completed deadline. Values are in tenths of a million (FPL convention) - e.g. 1005 == £100.5m.

Response 200: `{"bank_tenths": <int|null>, "squad_value_tenths": <int|null>}` (null before the first deadline of a season has passed).

401 if not connected, 502 if FPL is unreachable.
